::: {.col-lg-8 .col-md-10 .portfolio-item .filter-register .event-overview-detail}
### [Register](/register.html)

SoCal BOOM welcomes students, postdoctoral researchers, faculty, and other scientists interested in marine biogeochemistry. The detailed page will carry the current registration form, eligibility, deadlines, attendance capacity, and other updates.

- [Registration details](/register.html)
- [Frequently asked questions](/faqs.html)
- [Contact the organizing team](/contact.html)
:::

::: {.col-lg-8 .col-md-10 .portfolio-item .filter-present .event-overview-detail}
### Present

The scientific program highlights graduate-student and postdoctoral research through full-length talks, lightning talks, and poster presentations.

- [Meeting schedule](/scientific-program/schedule.html)
- [Abstract and presenter information](/scientific-program/abstracts.html)
- [Presenter FAQs](/faqs.html)
:::
